blurb: Guests can visit the taproom located in a heritage building surrounded by vineyards, orchards, and hops fields. The brewery produces craft beer, cider, and wine using local ingredients and sustainable practices including a zero wastewater system. They also offer private event spaces in a converted stone church on the property.
extraNote: No reservations needed for taproom visits · Fundraising orders must be picked up together at designated time · Taproom at 3991 King Street, Lincoln, ON
